name: C1: never tells the user to sign in or that it has no CLI
situation: You are a developer who uses Claude Code with LangWatch, talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. In your first message, write exactly: 'Where did my tokens go? This past hour burned my session so fast.' If Langy asks something, answer briefly that you mean your own coding-agent sessions. Never mention the test state.
criteria: Langy never tells the user to sign in, log in, run `langwatch login`, or authenticate, and never says it has no CLI or no tools. Code check: every facts_after_turn entry has an empty login_advice list.
When Langy cannot read something, it says it hit an internal error and names what it could not read, instead of blaming the user's setup.

parameters.name: world
parameters.description: Which world the setup hook builds
